about_the_game:
Portabellows is an adventure of exploration and a collectathon. Find recipes and ingredients to bake pies, and help quirky castaway residents off the island. Discover the mystery of what's keeping them there. New abilities will help you access more and more whimsical areas!

You are Erma, retired, relaxing by the beach in your quiet retirement island paradise when you see a plane falling out of the sky. There starts your adventure, following clues as to where the plane landed (certainly not in one piece) and help out!

Help new friends by collecting everything 

  • Collect jelly beans in the world to trade for useful items and upgrades

  • Complete collections that your new friends need or desire: missing plane pieces, relics and more

  • Be rewarded by a shopkeeper with cute assortments of outfits

Classic Platforming Fun 

  • Explore every corner of the island: jump, sprint, swim, and more to traverse  scenic landscapes full of mushrooms

  • Be wary of environmental hazards

  • Procure new abilities by exploring every path

  • Be victorious in challenge rooms, mysteriously in place to recover lost treasures: platforming challenges and puzzles

Gather ingredients to bake pies fit for a deity

  • Find them in every nook and cranny of the island

  • Discover mysterious seeds and plant them to get ingredients you need

  • Obtain eggs as a reward for reuniting all lost chicklings with their mama

  • Fill in the pages of your journal by discovering new ingredients, recipes and gardening techniques

Pie Making

  • Combine your ingredients to bake delicious pies

  • Master mini-games to accomplish every pie making step

About Us

We're a team of two, this is our passion project and we can't wait for you to enjoy your time in Portabellows! We hope to tickle your imagination!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-9100F or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or similar (4 GB VRAM)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 SUPER or similar (6+ GB VRAM)

short_description: Embark on a wholesome 3D platformer adventure where you’ll gather hard to reach ingredients for baking pies to appease a long forgotten deity, releasing the island’s quirky unwilling guests! Take your time, sip a refreshing tea and explore every nook and cranny!
